content: Řxedmet n Arebbi deg wuř n yinni dayes umnen
Cimɛun Buṭrus, amsexxar d rrasul n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, i inni ittwaḥesben am neccin ssdaheǧen l’iman s tsegda n Siditneɣ d Umsenjem nneɣ, Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, ɛlaḥsab ccan d ijjen akidneɣ.
Arḍa d řehna ad ɣarwem mmarenyen xmi i ɣa tessnem Siditneɣ, Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ,
am Wenni iwcin marra min iǧan zi jjehd n AREBBI, maḥend ad yiwi Tudart d tiggʷudi zi AREBBI s tussna n Wenni d aneɣ dd-iřaɣan ɣar uɛuǧi nnes d lɛaḍama nnes,
d Wenni zzayes Netta iwca awem lwuɛud imɣaren iɣřan aṭṭas, ḥima ad zzaysen tcarcem di ṭṭbiɛet nnes n AREBBI, am tᵉttrakkʷarem zi nnecwat iɣeccen i yeǧan di ddunect.
Am teǧa tmesřact ammu, arnim s marra cḍaret i l’iman nwem tcuni ifeyyḍen, i tcuni nwem ifeyyḍen tussna,
i tussna řewɛaret, i řewɛaret ṣṣbar, i ṣṣbar tiggʷudi zi AREBBI,
i tiggʷudi zi AREBBI tayri i wawmaten u i tayri i wawmaten tayri.
Mařa ttwafent daywem timesřayin-a uca ad daywem feyyḍent, war kenniw ttejjint texwam niɣ břa řɣiǧet di tussna n Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Minzi wenni war ɣar ǧint tmesřayin-a, aqa iddarɣeř, minzi war ittwiři illa ittu asizdeg n ddnub nnes inni tuɣa xas.
S uyenni, a aytma, cḍarem ktar ḥima ad tḍemnem tařaɣit d usixḍar nwem s řexdayem tiṣebḥanin, minzi mařa teggem aya, xenni ɛemmarṣ ad tenqarḍem.
Minzi ammu i d awem ɣa immarni s waṭṭas wadaf icnan ɣar tgeldit ittduman n Siditneɣ d Umsenjem nneɣ, Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Amtan n l’iman nneɣ
S uyenni war ttejjiɣ ad kenniw ssɛeqřeɣ zi man aya řebda, waxxa kenniw tessnem u aqa kenniw tbeddem x dsas n tidett tanita.
Maca ittɣiř ayi nican min ɣa kkeɣ ɛad di arrimet-a, ḥima ad kenniw ssfaqeɣ am ssɛeqřeɣ kenniw,
minzi ssneɣ aqa takessit n arrimet inu ad dd-tas deɣya, am mammec d ayi issargeb Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Maca ad ggeɣ tizemmar, ḥima ad tɛeqřem x tmesřayin-a awarni uffuɣ inu.
Minzi neccin war neḍfar ca tiḥuja isaysen, umi tuɣa d awem nettbarreḥ jjehd d twasit n Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, maca aqa neched s tiṭṭawin nneɣ x lɛaḍama nnes.
Minzi Netta aqa iṭṭef zi AREBBI Babas ccan d uɛuǧi umi d as dd-tusa tmijja-ya zeg uɛuǧi i dd-yusin ak-d lɛaḍama nnes: “Wa d Mmi inu iɛizzen wenni dayes ufiɣ arḍa inu.”
Uřa d neccin nesřa tmijja-ya zeg ujenna, umi tuɣa issawař akides, řami neǧa akides x wedrar iqeddsen.

Uřa d neccin ɣarneɣ awař d tidett n inabiyyen, u kenniw ad teggem mliḥ mařa tewcim taynit i wawař nni am i yijj n řefnar yareqqen deg ijj n wemcan ibbubbes, ař ɣa idduqqez wass uca ad tenqar tfuct deg wuřawen nwem.
Amezwar ittxeṣṣa kenniw ad tessnem aqa war din uřa d ict n nnubuwa tᵉnnufseř x tira nnes iqeddsen.
Minzi min ittwanabben war dd-itteffiɣ ɛemmarṣ zi min ixs bnadem, maca yusa-dd zeg uqemmum n yeryazen iqeddsen n AREBBI nni issiwřen am d asen dd-indeh Arruḥ Iqeddsen.
